game.title: Need for Speed Unbound
game.blurb: Street-racing game set in the city of Lakeshore, with races, Takeover events and cop chases, from Criterion Games, released 2022-11-29. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story in Lakeshore
chapters.summary: The story mode and its crew. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Races, Takeovers and Cash
chapters.summary: Street races, Takeover events, top speed, Burst Nitrous, distance and earning money in story mode.

chapters.title: Cop Chases
chapters.summary: Escaping high-Heat chases and taking down cops.

chapters.title: Activities and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Speed Runs, Long Jumps, Drift Zones, Speed Traps, and the bear, billboard and street art collectibles.

chapters.title: Garage and Style
chapters.summary: Upgrading the story garage, owning cars, wraps, clothing and driving effects.

chapters.title: Lakeshore Online
chapters.summary: The online mode: playlists by tier, its garage and its own goals.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for this game (API returned missing for "Need for Speed Unbound" and for "Need for Speed: Unbound"). needforspeed.fandom.com gave no page under "Need for Speed Unbound" but answers the API under "Need for Speed: Unbound", with about 161 linked pages, many of them other series games from a navigation box; its own subpages include "Story", "Events", "Lakeshore Online", "Speed Pass" and "Volume 1" to "Volume 6"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Excalibur" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1846380. 5 of 41 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low.
